passages.text: Modern households rely on dependable electric appliances to maintain everyday comfort, safety, and hygiene. Early Saturday morning, Mr. David began his weekend household routine in his bright, modern apartment. As soon as his bedside digital alarm sounded at seven o'clock, he stepped into the tidy kitchen to prepare breakfast. While brewing hot espresso using his compact coffee machine, he pressed a small button on the countertop to activate the ceiling fan, creating a gentle and refreshing breeze throughout the dining area. In the background, he turned on the kitchen radio to listen to soothing acoustic melodies and morning weather forecasts. Before tackling the laundry, he carefully checked the water inlet valve behind the washing equipment to ensure smooth water flow without leaks. The kitchen refrigerator, crafted with a sleek brushed metal finish, hummed quietly while its advanced cooling technology kept milk, fresh berries, and vegetables perfectly chilled. After enjoying his warm meal, David retrieved the cordless vacuum cleaner to remove pet hair and tiny crumbs from the living room rug. Suddenly, the cheerful chime of the front door bell rang out across the hallway, announcing the arrival of his neighbor with fresh garden herbs. As they chatted near the stove, a little smoke from toasted bread drifted upwards, briefly triggering the ceiling smoke alarm before David quickly opened the balcony doors. Utilizing efficient electrical devices simplifies daily domestic chores and protects home safety. Thoughtful maintenance of household machinery saves valuable electrical energy and ensures lasting reliability. When modern appliances function harmoniously, families enjoy a peaceful, convenient, and orderly living environment every day.

passages.text: Renovating a family kitchen requires choosing dependable appliances that balance culinary convenience, thermal efficiency, and home comfort. Across the room, Lucas preheated the electric oven to bake fresh herb bread, noting how its thermal insulation glass prevented heat from escaping into the room. To preserve groceries during warm summer months, the modern kitchen features a spacious stainless steel fridge that keeps milk, fruit, and vegetables crisp. For weekend outdoor picnics, Lucas also cleaned a portable insulated cooler to store chilled beverages. When winter temperatures drop, the apartment's central heating system maintains an even, cozy warmth throughout every living space. Using well-maintained domestic appliances saves valuable electrical power while streamlining daily cooking and cleaning routines. Regular cleaning prevents mineral buildup in water pipes and ensures that heating coils operate safely without overheating. Taking good care of domestic machinery prolongs the lifespan of expensive equipment, giving families lasting peace of mind. By combining durable kitchen tools, energy-efficient fixtures, and reliable heating devices, homeowners create an inviting, functional sanctuary where family members gather with joy every day.

passages.title: Smart Airflow and Everyday Home Appliances
passages.text:
Modern household appliances quietly handle countless daily chores, saving families valuable time and physical energy. From the moment an electric kettle boils morning water to evening laundry cycles spinning steadily in the utility room, dependable machines keep modern living spaces clean, comfortable, and well organized. Among all home devices, machines that manage indoor air circulation and temperature play an especially noticeable role across changing seasons.

In bathrooms and bedrooms, a handheld hair blower quickly dries damp hair before school or work while compact ceiling fans prevent stagnant humid air from lingering after warm showers. In the living room and basement, energy-efficient air purifiers draw airborne dust and pollen through pleated filters, helping households breathe easier during spring allergy months. Meanwhile, central heating systems rely on an internal furnace blower to push warmed air smoothly through wall vents into every upstairs bedroom during frosty winter nights.

Floor care and kitchen appliances also depend heavily on carefully engineered motors and airflow channels. Modern upright vacuum cleaners create strong suction that lifts fine pet hair from thick woven rugs, while automated dishwashers finish rinsing ceramic plates with gentle heated drying vents. Even outdoor yard tools mirror indoor appliance design: lightweight cordless leaf blowers share similar rechargeable lithium batteries with handheld workshop vacuums.

Caring for household appliances extends their lifespan and lowers monthly electricity bills. Regularly rinsing lint screens, wiping dust from cooling vents, and replacing clogged vacuum filters prevent motors from overheating. By choosing durable, energy-saving machines and performing simple weekly maintenance, families enjoy quiet, reliable home comfort throughout the entire year.
passages.textVi:
Các thiết bị gia dụng hiện đại âm thầm xử lý vô số công việc nhà hàng ngày, giúp các gia đình tiết kiệm thời gian quý báu và sức lực. Từ khoảnh khắc chiếc ấm đun siêu tốc đun sôi nước buổi sáng cho đến những chu trình giặt giũ buổi tối quay đều đặn trong phòng giặt, những cỗ máy đáng tin cậy giữ cho không gian sống hiện đại luôn sạch sẽ, thoải mái và ngăn nắp. Trong số mọi thiết bị gia đình, những chiếc máy điều hòa lưu thông không khí và nhiệt độ trong nhà đóng vai trò đặc biệt rõ rệt qua các mùa thay đổi.

Trong phòng tắm và phòng ngủ, máy sấy tóc cầm tay nhanh chóng làm khô mái tóc ẩm trước giờ đi học hay đi làm, trong khi quạt trần nhỏ gọn ngăn hơi ẩm tù đọng quẩn quanh sau khi tắm nước ấm. Ở phòng khách và tầng hầm, máy lọc không khí tiết kiệm điện hút bụi lơ lửng và phấn hoa qua màng lọc xếp nếp, giúp gia đình hít thở dễ chịu hơn trong những tháng dị ứng mùa xuân. Trong khi đó, hệ thống sưởi trung tâm dựa vào quạt thổi bên trong lò sưởi để đẩy luồng khí ấm nhẹ nhàng qua các khe thông gió trên tường tới từng phòng ngủ tầng trên vào những đêm đông giá rét.

Các thiết bị chăm sóc sàn nhà và nhà bếp cũng phụ thuộc rất nhiều vào động cơ và đường dẫn khí được thiết kế tỉ mỉ. Máy hút bụi đứng hiện đại tạo lực hút mạnh mẽ giúp nhấc sạch lông thú cưng mảnh khỏi những tấm thảm dệt dày, trong khi máy rửa bát tự động hoàn tất việc tráng đĩa sứ bằng luồng khí sấy ấm nhẹ nhàng. Ngay cả dụng cụ sân vườn ngoài trời cũng mô phỏng thiết kế gia dụng trong nhà: máy thổi lá không dây gọn nhẹ dùng chung loại pin lithium sạc lại tương tự máy hút bụi cầm tay xưởng nhà.

Việc chăm sóc thiết bị gia dụng giúp kéo dài tuổi thọ máy và giảm hóa đơn tiền điện hàng tháng. Thường xuyên rửa lưới lọc xơ vải, lau bụi khỏi khe tản nhiệt và thay bộ lọc máy hút bụi bị tắc sẽ ngăn động cơ bị quá nhiệt. Bằng cách chọn những cỗ máy bền bỉ, tiết kiệm năng lượng và thực hiện bảo dưỡng đơn giản hàng tuần, các gia đình tận hưởng sự tiện nghi yên tĩnh và đáng tin cậy suốt cả năm.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How do central heating systems distribute warm air throughout multi-story homes in winter?
options: They use an internal furnace blower to push warmed air through wall vents into upstairs rooms.
They pump boiling water directly across carpeted living room floors.
They open all exterior basement windows during freezing midnight storms.
They rely solely on handheld hair dryers placed inside bathroom sinks.

They both operate using cast-iron wood stoves buried under the lawn.
They both wash and rinse ceramic dinner plates inside kitchen cabinets.
They require connecting high-pressure garden hoses directly to ceiling fans.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Which simple maintenance habits help protect appliance motors and lower electricity bills?
options: Rinsing lint screens, wiping dust off cooling vents, and replacing clogged vacuum filters.
Covering all motor cooling vents tightly with thick plastic packing tape.
Running empty dishwashers continuously with broken heating elements.
Soaking electric kettles and cordless batteries in soapy bathwater weekly.
